output.notes: Described the English RoFormer used for pre-training and GLUE: bert-base-uncased with its position encoding replaced by RoPE applied to q and k. All size and flavour values except RoPE and the 512 context length are inherited from BERT-base; the paper itself does not restate them. The paper says it replaces BERT's 'sinusoidal' position encoding, but BERT actually uses learned absolute embeddings. I assumed the additive position table is removed, which matches the RoPE-only description. RoPE pairing is adjacent (interleaved), theta 10000, full head dimension rotated. Variants not described here: the MT model (Transformer-base encoder-decoder, 37k joint BPE vocab), Performer+RoPE (12 layers, 768 dim, 12 heads, linear attention, char level), and the Chinese WoBERT-based RoFormer (dims not stated).
